free_tier.stated: No published per-account byte or sequence-count quota; described as 'an open source, open submission web application server' and 'one of the biggest repositories for metagenomic data'.

egress.terms: Free. 'Data publicly available in MG-RAST is available without restrictions', with an API site at api.mg-rast.org for programmatic access.

tooling: Documented REST API (api.mg-rast.org/api.html) for submission and retrieval; web upload; standard metagenome formats (FASTA/FASTQ) with automatic phylogenetic/functional annotation.
chaining: Unlimited public datasets per account; no published aggregate cap, so the unit is the dataset.

reliability_note: Best-effort service with an explicit no-guarantee clause ('we cannot guarantee correctness of results, integrity of data, or privacy') and a 120-day deletion right on private data; funded by NIH/NSF grants, so continuity tracks grant cycles.
